description: This file contains unit tests for the RialtoLogging module, using Google Test framework. It tests logging behavior, handler setup, and log level filtering for different components.

classes.name: RialtoLoggingTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing the RialtoLogging module, including setup, teardown, and log handler testing methods.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, resetting the handler call count.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after each test (empty in this case).

methods.name: TestLogHandler
methods.description: A static method acting as a log handler that increments a global counter when invoked.

methods.name: EmptyLogHandler
methods.description: A static method acting as a log handler that does nothing.

methods.name: TestExpectLogCalls
methods.description: A method that triggers various log levels and verifies if the handler was called based on the expected log levels.
